bagPolicy.summary: MetLife Stadium allows clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small non-clear purses up to 4.5" x 6.5". All bags are subject to inspection before entry.
allowed: Clear bags that are 12" x 6" x 12" or less
Small non-clear purses/handbags (clutch-type bags) that are 4.5" x 6.5" or less
prohibited: Any type of non-clear bag exceeding 4.5” x 6.5”
Seat cushions of any size except those for medical needs
bagPolicy.note: An exception will be made for medically necessary items after proper inspection.

parking.note: Parking for tours is free and available in Lot F or G. Visitors should enter through the MetLife Gate located between the Moody's and Verizon Gates.

rideshare.note: Taxi and Limousine Drop-Off and Pick Up There is curb space along the roadway that provides a safe area for drop-offs and pick-ups.

concessions.note: MetLife Stadium offers a variety of food and drink options, with alcohol sales managed by Delaware North. Guests are limited to purchasing two alcoholic beverages at a time, and sales end at the beginning of the third quarter for football games.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: ADA accessible seating throughout. Accessible parking available. Elevator access on all levels.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: Box Office at stadium, check event details for hours. Photo ID required.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Multiple gates, check your ticket for your specific gate. Located in East Rutherford, NJ.
